[[Sofia]] | capacity = 10,000 | chairman = | manager = [[Kostadin Angelov]] | league = [[Regional Football Groups|B RFG Sofia Capital]] South | season = | position = | pattern_la1 = _whiteborder|pattern_b1=|pattern_ra1=_whiteborder | leftarm1 = 77BBFF|body1=77BBFF|rightarm1=77BBFF|shorts1=1A2D69|socks1=77BBFF | pattern_la2 = |pattern_b2=|pattern_ra2= | leftarm2 = FFD800|body2=FFD800|rightarm2=FFD800|shorts2=1A2D69|socks2=FFD800 }} '''Akademik Sofia''' ({{langx|bg|Академик}}) is a [[Bulgaria]]n [[Football (soccer)|football]] club from [[Sofia]], which competes in the [[Regional Football Groups|B RFG Sofa Capital]] South, the fifth division of the [[Bulgarian football league system]].The team's [[Akademik Stadium|stadium]] is located in the [[Slatina, Bulgaria|Slatina]] municipality of Sofia and its capacity is 10,000. Akademik was founded in 1947 by students from the [[Sofia University]] and debuted in [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|A PFG]] in 1949. The team would quickly establish itself as a top flight team in Bulgarian football in the next decades. Akademik became one of the top Bulgarian teams in the 1950s and 1970s, performing strongly in the domestic and European competitions alike, having been crowned [[Balkans Cup]] champion in 1974, among other achievements. Akademik's last appearance in the Bulgarian First League came in [[2010–11 A Group|2010-11]], after which the club experienced financial problems and folded after the 2011–12 season. In August 2026 the team was restored and started from fifth league."}}
